{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue column by removing commas and converting to float
data['revenue_float'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue_float == 999999.99)
qa_orders = data[data['revenue_float'] == 999999.99]

# Total completed orders (including QA)
total_completed = (data['status'] == 'completed').sum()

# Completed orders excluding QA orders
completed_excluding_qa = total_completed - len(qa_orders)

# Print final result
print(completed_excluding_qa)"}
